scripts.clean:plugin: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');function walk(d){for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d)){const p=path.join(d,f);const s=fs.statSync(p);if(s.isDirectory()){if(p.includes(path.join('plugin','sdk')))continue;walk(p);}else if(f.endsWith('.js')){const ts=p.replace(/\.js$/,'.ts');if(fs.existsSync(ts)){fs.unlinkSync(p);console.log('removed',p);}}}}walk('plugin');"
